labels.title: Labels
labels.noItem: Select an item to generate its label.
labels.exactTag: Enter the ID exactly, including hyphens and leading zeros.
labels.manualOnly: Create the label using the printer’s keyboard. The PT-E300 cannot receive labels from this app.
labels.step1: Press Bar Code and select CODE128.
labels.step2: Enable Under # for readable text. Use Large barcode width where it fits.
labels.step3: Confirm, type the exact asset ID shown here, and confirm the barcode.
labels.step4: Print on black-on-white tape. Scan the label and check the matching item before attaching it.

rental.bufferHelp: Scan labels or select inventory checkboxes. Your selection is shared between Inventory and Scan.
rental.locked: Feasibility means Admin has verified the physical return. Rental fields are locked. Select another status to enter rental details; only Admin can return an item to Feasibility. For a mixed selection, choose a rental status first.
rental.requiredHelp: A renter is required outside Feasibility. For Customer, Note must include the customer’s name.
rental.customerRequired: Note must contain the customer’s name.
rental.renterRequired: Personnel renting the device is required.
rental.adminReturn: Only Admin can change an item back to Feasibility.
rental.inactivePerson: Select an active person from the directory.
rental.bulkHelp: Untouched fields keep each item’s value. Every item must pass validation; a bulk save is all-or-nothing.
rental.loadError: Could not load rental options. Retry before saving.
rental.inventoryHelp: Select equipment to update its rental details. Admin manages equipment records.
rental.scanHelp: Scan one or more labels to add equipment to the shared rental buffer above.
rental.selectPage: Select all items on this page
rental.directoryHelp: Manage who may rent equipment. Deactivation preserves existing rentals and prevents new assignments.
rental.accountHelp: Admin is the only authenticated account. Editor is public rental mode and does not require an account.
